routes.name: giffgaff UK mobile number
routes.form: physical SIM or eSIM on supported devices

cost.purchase: Physical SIM ordering is free from giffgaff, but delivery is UK-address only; eSIM is available through the giffgaff app. Recheck current plan/credit cost before activation.
cost.recurring: No fixed monthly plan is required for the inactivity rule itself. Perform at least one qualifying use or airtime/plan purchase within every 6 months.

retention.rule: Do at least one qualifying action before six months of inactivity: a qualifying call/SMS/MMS, mobile-data connection, airtime credit purchase or plan purchase.
retention.recovery: Once deactivated for inactivity the SIM cannot be reactivated. giffgaff says a PAC may be requested from agents within 30 days after deactivation to move the number to another UK network.

friction.identity: Current account/payment requirements must be checked at signup; the cited help pages do not establish a universal passport/KYC requirement.
friction.location: Physical SIM delivery is UK-address only. Roaming is supported in many countries, but Wi-Fi Calling is not supported abroad. eSIM activation geography still needs explicit verification before production.
friction.device: Unlocked compatible phone required; eSIM requires a supported device and the giffgaff app.
friction.ongoing: Very low-frequency keep-alive action; set a reminder well before the 6-month inactivity boundary.

routes.name: Lebara UK PAYG mobile number
routes.form: physical SIM; eSIM on supported devices

cost.purchase: Physical PAYG SIM is currently offered free; plans currently start from GBP 5. Recheck checkout and delivery availability.
cost.recurring: PAYG is available without a fixed 30-day plan. A chargeable activity is needed within 90 days to avoid temporary barring/credit loss; after a further 365 days without usage or top-up/plan purchase the SIM expires.

retention.rule: Make at least one chargeable activity before 90 consecutive days of inactivity. If barred after 90 days, add credit or buy a plan to resume service. After a further 365 days with no usage or top-up/plan purchase, the SIM expires and a new number is required.
retention.recovery: Top up or buy a plan during the recoverable inactivity period. For a critical account, do not wait until final expiry before porting or changing recovery numbers.

friction.identity: A universal passport/ID requirement has not been established by the official pages reviewed. eSIM purchase requires a Lebara account and verified email.
friction.location: Critical constraint: Lebara says the SIM/eSIM must be activated in the UK before taking it abroad. eSIM can be ordered outside the UK but must be activated in the UK.
friction.device: Unlocked phone required. eSIM support is device-dependent and currently phased; confirm your device before purchase.
friction.ongoing: PAYG or plan-based. International roaming outside included regions may require PAYG credit or a roaming add-on.

routes.name: Mobal Japan Voice+Data 5G number
routes.form: physical SIM or eSIM with a real 070/080/090 Japanese mobile number

cost.purchase: Current official list pricing shows a JPY 4,950 SIM purchase price before temporary promotions; recheck checkout because discounts change.
cost.recurring: Voice+Data plans currently start from JPY 1,650 per calendar month. Outgoing calls/SMS and optional roaming can add charges.

retention.rule: Keep the monthly service active. Mobal states that if the service is terminated, the assigned Japanese phone number is lost and a future service requires a new number.
retention.recovery: Do not cancel a Mobal line tied to important accounts until those accounts have been migrated. A terminated Mobal number is not retained for later reuse.

friction.identity: Voice-capable products require identity verification under Japanese law. Delivery requires an accepted ID upload and delivery to the address shown on the ID; collection requires the physical valid passport. Voice customers must be 18+.
friction.location: Orders can be arranged with worldwide delivery or Japan pick-up. Activation requests are submitted through the Mobal account; the line receives its Japanese number only after activation. Japan pick-up requires passport presentation.
friction.device: Unlocked compatible phone required. For voice, device/VoLTE compatibility matters; eSIM requires native eSIM support.
friction.ongoing: Monthly service until manually terminated. International voice/SMS roaming is an optional paid feature on the latest Voice+Data 5G product; data roaming is not supported.
